project_info.theme: avant-garde luxury beauty campaign with monumental lipstick sculpture
project_info.color_palette: monochrome crimson, glossy black, metallic gold, warm skin tones, and bright red

main_subject.description: An elegant adult woman with refined features and a poised couture presence.
main_subject.wardrobe: Dramatic black asymmetrical evening gown with a structured bodice, elegant high slit, and sculptural drape; polished heels and minimal jewelry.
main_subject.pose: Standing confidently atop the red lipstick bullet with one hand on her hip in a powerful couture pose.
main_subject.styling: Luxury beauty editorial with polished updo, refined makeup, and a bold red lip.

composition_elements.framing: Square ultra-clean campaign composition with the lipstick centered as a monumental pedestal and the adult subject clearly visible above it.
composition_elements.environment: Monochrome crimson studio backdrop with glossy reflective floor and giant black serif typography reading BOLD behind the subject.
composition_elements.focus: Sharp couture gown, adult subject, red lipstick bullet and metallic casing, floor reflection, and legible BOLD typography.

lighting_and_atmosphere.lighting: Cinematic luxury beauty lighting with crisp highlights on the lipstick and gown, controlled shadows, and a polished reflective floor glow.
lighting_and_atmosphere.atmosphere: Bold, dramatic, luxurious, sculptural, and museum-like.

technical_specs.camera: Full-frame camera with a 50mm lens at f/5.6, 1/200 s, ISO 100
technical_specs.quality: Hyper-realistic high-resolution commercial beauty photography, sharp product texture, clean reflective surfaces, high contrast, professional campaign finish

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a hyper-realistic 1:1 avant-garde luxury beauty campaign with a monumental glossy red lipstick posed as a sculptural pedestal in a monochrome crimson studio. An elegant adult woman stands confidently atop the lipstick bullet in a dramatic black asymmetrical evening gown with structured couture drape and an elegant high slit, one hand on her hip, polished heels, refined makeup, and a bold red lip. Place giant black serif BOLD typography behind her, a glossy reflective floor below, cinematic luxury beauty lighting, crisp highlights on the lipstick and gown, controlled shadows, and no extra text or watermark. Preserve a clean museum-like premium campaign composition.
prompt.negative_prompt: minor, age ambiguity, unapproved identity, nudity, explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexual pose, explicit body measurements, wardrobe malfunction, illegible text, misspelled BOLD, distorted lipstick, deformed anatomy, extra limbs, watermark, cluttered background, flat lighting

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: No identity reference is required for this original adult subject. Optional gown, lipstick, typography, studio, or lighting references may replace only their named element; preserve the bold couture pose, elegant coverage, red-and-black palette, sculptural product pedestal, and BOLD campaign message.

assets.name: monumental-red-lipstick-pedestal
assets.usage: Replace only the lipstick shade, casing finish, or product proportions while preserving the adult subject's elevated pose.

assets.name: black-asymmetrical-couture-evening-gown
assets.usage: Replace only the gown design while preserving elegant coverage, couture structure, and the powerful pose.
